title: A card in Review gets its review even when the sweep closed its worker's pane
notes:
A card in Review whose review never started stays that way, unseen.

Seen twice on 2026-11-16, with #300 and #313. The card worker opened its PR and reported to main. The card moved to Review. Then the finished-worker sweep closed the worker's pane (main had read the report and sent nothing for a while), and no review loop ever ran. The PR had no review comments and no review pane. `board review <id>` started it by hand. For #306, the app did start the review by itself, so the gap is a race between the sweep and the review start.

Want:
- Find the race first: where the review start (review.autoLoop on a move into Review) and the sweep (closeAfterMinutes) meet, and why a closed pane loses the review. Cite file:line.
- Fix it at the root, so a card in Review with autoLoop on always gets its review. Either the sweep never closes a pane whose card is in Review with no review yet, or the follow/review sweep starts the review for any Review card whose PR has no loop running and no loop comment.
- One decision module, with a test for the case: worker done, card in Review, pane closed, so a review starts.
- Don't start a second review on a PR that already has one running or finished.
- Docs (ship, workers) change with it. Do not bump the version. Tests must be Windows-safe.

comments.body: PR #315. Root cause: sweepOne marks the card before its move into Review. The move waits on the board push, then review() re-checks the agent; a worker back at work by then was refused and the mark stayed for the rest of the run. Closing the pane later changed nothing. Fix: review() takes the mark off for early refusals (agent at work, project closed, card cancelled). Test in review-flow.test.ts. Follow-up, not fixed: with merging off a finished review leaves the card in Review, and an app restart reviews it again.
